nina: bringing up albatross-lite-int8 (onnx ptq) on staging. quick signal: silhouette down a lot but recall@10 only bad for very short queries (<6 tokens). anyone seen this?
omar: similar to other threads 73 but check embedding norms and per-head activation ranges. PTQ per-tensor tends to squash rare-dim directions.
claire: do you have breakdown by query length? short vs mid vs long?
nina: yes: onboard-smol (1.5k queries). fp recall@10 overall 0.75 -> int8 0.62. short(<=6) 0.79 -> 0.48, mid(7-30) 0.73 -> 0.70, long(>50) 0.69 -> 0.66. silhouette fp 0.39 -> 0.21. avg-l2 fp 1.10 -> int8 0.77.
dev-bot: quick summary for 3765432100:
```
model: albatross-lite-int8 (ptq onnx)
dataset: onboard-smol (1.5k)
metrics:
  recall@10: fp=0.75 -> int8=0.62
  recall@10 (<=6): fp=0.79 -> int8=0.48
  silhouette: fp=0.39 -> int8=0.21
  avg-l2: fp=1.10 -> int8=0.77
notes: norm compression + clustering variance concentrated on short queries.
```
claire: try per-channel quant or collect more calibration samples focused on short-query traffic. also try eval batch smaller (8-16) to reduce range underestimation.
omar: also run a kmeans k-sensitivity sweep (k=40..120) and check pairwise recall stability (recall@k per cluster).
nina: ran quick ablation: batch=8 + per-channel calib (256 samples) -> short recall@10 0.48 -> 0.63, silhouette 0.21 -> 0.33. that's big improvement.
claire: good sign. can you add a short-query holdout to the onboard checklist and a small-norm histogram check?
nina: yes adding to checklist and opened PR: https://git.redwood/albatross/PR-332. will queue a 12h synthetic run on dedicated-staging after merge.
dev-bot: queued per-channel run 551; results ETA ~10m.
claire: if residual gap remains, we should test a tiny post-embedding affine (learnable scale/shift) as a last-resort fix before rejecting the int8 variant.
omar: agree. logging the action items: 1) include short-query holdout in onboard checks, 2) calibrate per-channel with smaller eval batch and targeted samples, 3) run k-sensitivity and pairwise recall diagnostics, 4) schedule 12h synthetic traffic on dedicated-staging.
nina: thanks, will update with eval-bot output and PR link. :white_check_mark:
